reasons: Cited text (22.1–22.2) satisfies every element of the preferred position: one audit per twelve-month period, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems and unrelated Customer Data.

Section 22.3 adds Customer-favourable protections (findings treated as Customer Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of final report, payment resolves the issue), so no residual gap exists.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the paragraphs are returned unchanged; the deterministic frequency check also passes.
